text:
izzy: opened a tiny PR to fix inconsistent examples for the generate endpoint: some snippets showed `request_id` in body while others used `X-Request-Id` header. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1620

mike: Which form should be canonical?

izzy: Use header `X-Request-Id` as canonical in examples, and keep body `request_id` as a documented alias. PR adds an OpenAPI components/header entry and `x-sdk-alias: request_id` on the response schema so SDKs expose `resp.id`.

tara: Can we also add a short migration note for anyone parsing raw responses?

izzy: Added: "Prefer X-Request-Id header for tracing. SDKs expose resp.id and will read the header; body `request_id` remains for compatibility for one release."

docs-bot: Deploy preview: https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood.ai/1620  examples updated.

mike: Small nit: use canonical casing `X-Request-Id` in docs.

izzy: Done, updated curl/python/js snippets and the SSE docs to include event `event_id`. Merging after CI green. :white_check_mark:
__notes: Slack thread: concise docs PR coordination to standardize response id header vs body field and SDK aliasing
